commit.message:
fix(dunning-v2): R-DISPUTE-PAUSE on main's webhook - no DunningState lock before v1, clear on the webhook tx, re-read the pause under the clear's locks, won dispute keeps a paused plan revoked (C-680-19) (B-DUNMR-120)

- disputePaused reads the marker under the purchase lock only: a
  DunningState FOR UPDATE on the webhook tx blocked v1 recordResolution's
  own-connection write of that row until the 5 s tx timeout (flag off too).
- invoice.paid passes its tx to applyImmediateClear (the purchase lock is
  already held there; a second connection waited on it).
- applyImmediateClear re-reads the dispute pause under its locks.
- C-680-19: dispute won on a recurring plan without access keeps it
  disputed (revoked); only the coach restart grants access.
